# BULB

> > BULB is a Web3 social media platform that rewards creators and community members for engaging content about cryptocurrency, blockchain, and AI.

BULB combines social networking with write-to-earn mechanics, enabling creators to discuss Web3 topics, share insights on cryptocurrency markets, and build communities around blockchain technology. The platform features user profiles, threaded discussions, and content discovery through tags.

## Key Topics

- Web3
- Blockchain
- Cryptocurrency
- Bitcoin
- Solana
- BULB Token
- AI Tools
- DeFi
- Crypto Community
- Write-to-Earn
- Digital Marketing
- Crypto Exchanges
- Smart Contracts
- Online Earning
- Fintech

## Platform Core

- [BULB | Web3 Social Media Platform](https://www.bulbapp.io): BULB Web3 social platform for writers, creators, and community members
- [BULB | Rewarding Engagement](https://www.bulbapp.io/about): BULB platform overview: Web3 social media with write-to-earn rewards
- [BULB Threads | Web3 Social Media](https://www.bulbapp.io/thread): BULB Threads feature for crypto discussion and community engagement
- [Tags | BULB](https://www.bulbapp.io/tag): BULB tag directory for content discovery and categorization
